item.title: CSS Women’s Hoops Stays Unbeaten at Home By Taking Down Augsburg
item.description: DULUTH, Minn.- The St. Scholastica women’s basketball team improved to 3-0 at home on Wednesday, defeating Augsburg 68 to 48. CSS was led by Evie Schmitz, who had 23 points in the victory. The Saints (5-1) will next host Carleton on Saturday at 1 PM. Categories: College, Sports
